# Volume

A governed folder of files in the object store with an owner group and grants.

## Spec

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spec.catalog` | string | Yes |  | The catalog (Lakehouse) this volume belongs to; the owner group is inherited. | min 1, max 40; pattern `^[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$` |
| `spec.grants` | array of object | No | `[]` |  | max 20 |
| `spec.grants[].group` | string | Yes |  | The Keycloak group whose members hold these verbs. | min 1, max 64; pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$` |
| `spec.grants[].verbs` | array of string | Yes |  | At least one verb; each verb at most once. | min 1, max 3 |
| `spec.purpose` | string | No | `data` | What a volume holds. A `libraries` volume is code that every reader executes, so it restricts `write` to groups that also manage it. | `data`, `libraries` |
| `spec.storage` | object | Yes |  | Where a volume's files live: exactly one of platform-managed storage or an external prefix. Files live in the volume bucket, never in the table bucket. |  |
| `spec.storage.external` | object (nullable) | No |  | A prefix in the customer's own bucket, reached through an `s3` connection. |  |
| `spec.storage.external.connection` | string | Yes |  | Name of the `s3` connection that holds the endpoint, bucket and credentials. | min 1, max 40; pattern `^[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$` |
| `spec.storage.external.prefix` | string (nullable) | No |  | Key prefix inside the bucket; absent means the prefix the connection already scopes. | max 512; pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_./-]*$` |
| `spec.storage.managed` | object (nullable) | No |  | Storage the platform owns: the volume gets `volumes/<catalog>/<name>/` in the platform object store. `managed: {}` selects it. |  |

## Validation rules

- storage must be either managed or external, not both and not neither
- an external prefix must not contain .. or //
- each group may appear once in grants
- a verb may appear once per grant
- on a libraries volume only a group that also manages it may write
